python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, re, subprocess, sys
files = subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','--diff-filter=AM'], text=True).splitlines()
if not files:
    print('NO_FORMAT_DIFF')
    sys.exit(2)
for name in files:
    p = pathlib.Path(name)
    before = subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'HEAD:{name}'])
    after = p.read_bytes()
    strip = lambda b: re.sub(rb'\s+', b'', b)
    if strip(before) != strip(after):
        print(f'NON_WHITESPACE_CHANGE {name}')
        sys.exit(3)
print('FORMAT_ONLY_NONWHITESPACE_IDENTITY_PASS')
print('CHANGED_FILES=' + ','.join(files))
